newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crude grades ride out to close on firmer note.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crude grades ride out to close on firmer note.

text.p: U.S. crude grades gained all session Tuesday, firming in both sweet and sour markets on sentiment the domestics are the current crude of choice.
The price for bringing over Brent and other trans-Atlantic barrels has turned buyers to the home-grown grades, not to mention the lack of foreign crudes recently on offer.
Outright crude prices ended slightly weaker in a subdued session, leaving March West Texas Intermediate/Cushing 5 cents lower at $22.35-45 a barrel.
American Petroleum Institute stock data, released late Tuesday, was seen bearish for crude and gas, bullish for heat.
